name: Necrophobia
source:
Start your life anew at Heaven's Gates Academy. Learn new subjects, make new friends, experience what you've never before deemed possible. Change your fate, and the fate of those around you- your decisions matter greatly.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2906710/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在天堂之门学院重新开始你的生活。学习新科目，结交新朋友，体验你以前认为不可能的事情。改变你的命运，以及你周围人的命运——你的决定非常重要。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2906710/]Steam[/url]]
